# 🧰 Maintenance Checklist

## 📅 Scheduled review
- [ ] Check dependency advisories and supported versions.
- [ ] Review CI results and flaky checks.
- [ ] Verify documentation links and route inventory.
- [ ] Review security and privacy guidance.
- [ ] Review known issues and technical debt.
- [ ] Confirm backups and recovery where configured.
- [ ] Review third-party notices and licenses.
- [ ] Review accessibility/performance findings.
- [ ] Remove stale claims and obsolete instructions.
- [ ] Record changes and next review date.
